safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no neck stiffness; generated facts do not mention neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag screen for meningitis/SAH; omitting a documented denial can weaken the safety-net/triage picture for future clinicians. Because the finding is negative, the more likely impact is documentation/hand-off inefficiency rather than direct under-treatment.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no fever; generated facts do not mention fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is an important associated symptom when evaluating acute severe headache for infectious causes; omitting a denial reduces the completeness of red-flag documentation. As this was a negative finding, it is more likely to cause unnecessary follow-up questions than immediate clinical harm.
